final_critic_line: Ten thousand ring-singers were chasing one another's note until it cracked the ice under Lowmark; Illuminara learned they had lost the neighbour who could hear them, failed once by becoming the louder noise, then let a nine-year-old's tired tin flute and a town's own choices bring the chord back and the cannons down.
